correctness.rationale: For K_(d,t), inclusion–exclusion in each sign orthant gives vol(K)=2^d/d! sum_(j=0)^floor(t) (-1)^j C(d,j)(t-j)^d, including knots. The support h_K(y) fills the k largest |y_i| first (fractional knapsack): sum_(i=1)^k z_i+(t-k)z_(k+1). On each signed and ordered chamber z_i=sum_(j>=i)u_j, jacobian1 and polar inequality sum_(i<=k)i*u_i + t sum_(i>k)u_i <=1 give vol(K°)=2^d/(k!t^(d-k)). These are analytic all-d identities. The primal truncated-power formula is C^1 at internal integers d>=2, while polar log derivative jumps by1/m, giving P(m+)′-P(m-)′=P(m)/m>0. For d=3 independent SymPy differentiation confirms branch derivatives -32(2t^3-9t+6)/(3t^3) on (1,2) and 16(2t^3-9t²+21)/(3t²) on (2,3), strict concavity of first, unique zero of second branch derivative, cusp min at2, and endpoint product32/3. Independent exact Fraction spot checks in d=2..6 agree with stated P formula, including knots and endpoints. Distinct interior peak magnitudes follow the supplied exact rational inequalities.
